en_title: Beats by Dre Teases Pokémon Collaboration With an Electrified Beats Pill Speaker
subtitle: 电光与紫焰
opus_summary: Beats发布六秒预告，暗示将推出《宝可梦》联名无线音箱，尚未公布产品详情或发售日期。电光与紫焰可能指向皮卡丘和耿鬼设计，网上已有未经证实的产品图片流传。

paragraphs.en: Beats by Dre has teased an upcoming collaboration with Pokémon.
paragraphs.cn: Beats by Dre发布预告，透露即将与《宝可梦》展开联名合作。

paragraphs.en: A six-second video teaser posted to the official Beats by Dre YouTube channel shows the shadow of the Beats Pill speaker, enveloped by animated sparks and flames. The video, titled “Time to catch something new,” ends with an electrified Beats logo next to a Poké Ball.
paragraphs.cn: Beats by Dre官方YouTube频道发布了一段六秒预告，画面中，Beats Pill音箱的剪影被电火花和火焰动画包围。这段视频的标题为「是时候捕捉点新东西了」，结尾出现了带有电光效果的Beats标志，旁边是一颗精灵球。

paragraphs.en: The teaser video doesn’t offer any product or release date info, but suggests the collaboration will include a Pokémon-branded version of the company’s wireless speaker.
paragraphs.cn: 预告没有透露产品详情或发售日期，但暗示此次联名将包含一款《宝可梦》主题的Beats无线音箱。

paragraphs.en: The ‘electric’ animations suggest an unsurprising focus on the Pokémon mascot, Pikachu. To support that theory, unconfirmed images of a bright yellow Pikachu-themed speaker have already started circulating the web. The flaming purple animations point to a possible second product design, potentially inspired by another collaboration favorite, Gengar.
paragraphs.cn: 这些「电光」动画暗示，联名将以《宝可梦》的吉祥物皮卡丘为主角，这并不令人意外。网上已经开始流传一款亮黄色皮卡丘主题音箱的图片，虽未经证实，但也为这一猜测提供了支持。紫色火焰动画则暗示，可能还有第二款产品设计，灵感或许来自另一位联名常客——耿鬼。

paragraphs.en: The standard edition of the Beats Pill speaker currently retails for $149.99. We’ll likely get the full reveal of the Pokémon x Beats collaboration alongside a release date in the coming weeks.
paragraphs.cn: 标准版Beats Pill音箱目前的零售价为149.99美元(约合人民币1005元)。未来几周，我们很可能会看到《宝可梦》与Beats联名产品的完整介绍，以及发售日期。

paragraphs.en: Pokémon is celebrating its 30th anniversary this year, giving the biggest franchise in the world the excuse to drop more collaborations than ever. We’ve seen themed hardware from tech companies like Razer , shoe drops from Crocs , and even entire merch collections with retailers like Target .
paragraphs.cn: 《宝可梦》今年迎来30周年，这让这个全球最大的IP有了推出空前数量联名产品的理由。我们已经见到了雷蛇等科技公司的主题硬件、Crocs推出的联名鞋款，甚至还有与Target等零售商合作推出的整套周边系列。

paragraphs.en: The amount of buzz going into the Pokémon brand right now would suggest any collab with the gaming giant is an easy win. However, an ongoing scalping crisis in the TCG market continues to bleed into all things Pokémon , with some commenters on the Beats by Dre teaser already deriding the collab as “The beats shill.”
paragraphs.cn: 《宝可梦》品牌眼下的热度似乎表明，任何品牌只要与这个游戏巨头联名，就能轻松获得成功。然而，集换式卡牌市场持续的黄牛乱象仍在波及《宝可梦》的各类产品。Beats by Dre预告下已经有评论者将此次联名讥讽为「Beats圈钱货」。

paragraphs.en: Beats by Dre, which is owned by Apple, launched the first Beats Pill speaker back in 2012. The speaker has gone through a number of upgrades, most recently with a 2024 re-release focused on portability and power.
paragraphs.cn: 苹果旗下的Beats by Dre早在2012年就推出了首款Beats Pill音箱。这款音箱经历了多次升级，最近一次是在2024年重新推出，重点提升了便携性和功率。

paragraphs.en: One thing that hasn't changed is the company's commitment to collaborations. Remember when the Beats Pill popped up in pretty much every YouTube channel? Nowadays, the company focuses on unique themed designs, having recently released product lines with Jennie (of Blackpink fame) and Kim Kardashian.
paragraphs.cn: 有一点始终没变：Beats一直热衷于联名合作。还记得几乎每个YouTube频道都能看到Beats Pill的时候吗？如今，Beats更注重独特的主题设计，近期已与BLACKPINK成员Jennie以及金·卡戴珊合作推出了产品系列。
